name: WdShapeSizeRelative
description: Specifies whether the WidthRelative or HeightRelative property for a Shape or ShapeRange object is valid.

constants.name: wdShapeSizeRelativeNone
constants.description: Specifies that the WidthRelative or HeightRelative property is not currently valid, so the shape is positioned according to the value specified in the Left or Top property, respectively.
